summary: People invited through the AI Gateway 'notify your team' flow now join the organization with the limited AI_GATEWAY role (only gateway:read/gateway:invoke, no project access) instead of MEMBER; UI copy updated to say so.

statements.why: Change narrows permissions for new invitees (organizationAccessRights.ts: AI_GATEWAY = gateway:read, gateway:invoke; projectAccessRights AI_GATEWAY = []). Endpoint still protectedOrganizationProcedure.

statements.text: ExternalInviteeHint.tsx: it now shows "in the organization yet. They'll be invited to the organi…" and "role."
statements.why: Text did change, but the quoted fragments omit the point (they now join with the 'AI Gateway' role instead of 'Member').

statements.text: The agent also changed gatewayTeamInvites.ts and gatewayTeamService.ts, in ways plain can't describe yet.
statements.why: True but hides the actual behaviour change (orgRole MEMBER -> AI_GATEWAY in gatewayTeamService.ts:206).

misses.what: New people invited from the AI Gateway setup now get the limited 'AI Gateway' organization role (can use the gateway only, cannot see the organization's projects/traces) instead of full Member access. Anyone expecting invitees to see project data will need to change their role.
